### Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

---

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Launch `SAPatcher`
2. Configure settings (DXVK version, 4GB Patch, etc.)
3. Click on '...'
4. Launch the game via Motion Launcher
5. See error / crash / unexpected behavior

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
